name: Vampiric (Orphaned Bookworm Productions)
body:
Aura faint necromancy; CL 5th; Price +3 bonus; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This armor has motifs of fangs and bats and wolves throughout its design. Three times per day, when the wearer of vampiric armor is dealt damage by a melee attack the armor deals 3d6 damage to the attacking creature and the wearer regains hit points equal to the damage dealt.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells vampiric touch
